name: Rare Bird Brewpub
description: A TC institution housed in a beautifully restored 1931 red brick building downtown. Rare Bird uses only Michigan-grown hops and malt, producing distinctive house beers alongside a rotating craft selection. The food program is excellent — don't skip the Korean Pork Belly tacos.

name: Right Brain Brewery
description: One of TC's most creative breweries — Right Brain grows many of its own ingredients on-property including fruits, vegetables, flowers, honey, and hops. Located off Boardman Lake with a massive rotating tap list and an artistic, community-focused taproom known for wildly experimental recipes.

name: The Workshop Brewing Company
description: Consistently rated the best brewery in TC, Workshop anchors the creative Warehouse District. Committed to Michigan-grown ingredients, communal tables (some made from old church pews), and classic craft styles executed exceptionally well. A true gathering place for locals and visitors alike.

name: The Filling Station Microbrewery
description: A Boardman Lake favorite known for breakfast pizzas, beermosas, and a rotating tap list of house-crafted beers. Casual, welcoming vibe and a waterfront-adjacent location make it a go-to for a relaxed afternoon in TC.

name: North Peak Brewing Company
address: 400 W Front St, Traverse City, MI 49684
description: A downtown TC staple housed in a century-old candy factory. North Peak celebrates Northern Michigan with a cherry porter, local walleye fish fry, cheddar ale soup, and a rotating lineup of craft beers. A full pub menu and prime Front Street location make it one of TC's most visited spots.

name: MiddleCoast Brewing Company
address: 329 E State St, Traverse City, MI 49684
description: Located inside the State Street Market food hall, MiddleCoast offers approachable craft beers in a vibrant industrial-chic setting with multiple food vendors and outdoor seating. The Beach Please Blonde Ale and All Day Vacay IPA are summer staples.

name: Brewery Ferment
address: 1402 N Cedar St, Traverse City, MI 49686
description: A beloved neighborhood craft brewery combining an excellent taproom with a curated bottle shop. Brewery Ferment focuses on Belgian-influenced and farmhouse-style ales alongside classic American craft styles — a thoughtful, community-centered experience for serious beer lovers.

name: Brewery Terra Firma
description: Michigan's only agricultural brewery — built on a 10-acre MAEAP-certified farm minutes from downtown TC. Terra Firma grows many of its own brewing ingredients and recaptures waste heat and water throughout production. Culinary-inspired, whole-ingredient craft beers with an on-site beer garden and fire pits.

name: Earthen Ales
address: Grand Traverse Commons & 8th Street Tank Space, Traverse City
description: With two TC locations — the original in the historic Grand Traverse Commons and the Tank Space on 8th Street — Earthen Ales is a neighborhood favorite with a relaxed atmosphere, outside-food-welcome policy, and rotating taps of thoughtfully crafted beers. The Commons building, a former state psychiatric hospital, is one of the most atmospheric spots in TC.

name: Hop Lot Brewing
address: 658 S W Bay Shore Dr, Suttons Bay, MI 49682
description: Rated one of the best beer gardens in the country, Hop Lot is a family-friendly brewery tucked behind acres of hardwoods along M-22 in Suttons Bay. The on-site hop garden supplies fresh Cascade hops for rotating ales. In winter, a heated igloo village transforms the grounds into one of the most memorable cold-weather experiences in the TC region.

name: Jolly Pumpkin Restaurant & Brewery
description: A full-service restaurant and artisan brewery on Old Mission Peninsula, renowned for wild-fermented, Belgian-inspired ales made with native yeasts and aged in oak barrels. Features beers from Jolly Pumpkin Artisan Ales, North Peak Brewing, and Old Mission Beer Co., alongside one of the best dining rooms on the peninsula.

name: Lake Ann Brewing Company
description: A small, community-rooted brewery in the charming village of Lake Ann, about 15 minutes from Traverse City. Lake Ann Brewing's relaxed taproom sits across from a lovely park. The adjacent Stone Oven restaurant means you can bring excellent wood-fired food into the brewery. Small tap list, big local charm.

name: Silver Spruce Brewing Company
address: Two locations: 8th St & Silver Lake Rd, Traverse City
description: Silver Spruce operates two Traverse City taprooms focused on approachable, well-crafted classic styles. From light lagers to robust stouts, the emphasis is on brewing every style well rather than chasing trends. Two convenient TC locations make this an easy addition to any craft beer day.

name: Short's Brewing — Bellaire Pub
description: The original Short's pub in Bellaire is a pilgrimage destination for Michigan craft beer fans — a renovated 100-year-old hardware store serving 20 rotating Short's beers and Starcut Ciders alongside gourmet pizzas, sandwiches, and soups. Fearlessly creative brewing (Soft Parade, Huma Lupa Licious, dozens of seasonals) has made Short's one of the defining craft breweries in the Midwest. Worth every mile of the 45-minute drive.

name: Short's Brewing — Elk Rapids Pull Barn
address: 211 Industrial Park Dr, Elk Rapids, MI 49629
description: The Pull Barn at Short's Elk Rapids production facility is the laid-back counterpart to the Bellaire pub — nestled between Lake Michigan, Elk Lake, and Bass Lake with bay views, year-round outdoor seating, draft beers, experimental releases, and a bring-your-own-food policy. About 30 minutes north of Traverse City on US-31.
